items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: during the time we were with Benny Goodman at the Congress Hotel in the year of 1927

ctx.x: See, this boy I had that was a valet that I brought from Cleveland, he would do all the going to the front to the manager to get an advance on the salary or he'd go do errands where necessary, keep the car clean. Now my point I'm trying to bring out to you now is that this boy -- I had a contract later, I

had a contract with Buck, partnership contract. I thought I needed it 'cause I want to sign his name along with mine. I couldn't do it without his okay and I couldn't take no check that's signed Buck and Bubbles and I don't get the money either. It had come to that, but the point of it is I got the partnership in Chicago during the time we were with Benny Goodman at the Congress Hotel in the year of 1927 I think it was.

However, I got this partnership and we come to find out this boy that I had, this valet, he stole a briefcase I had in the car with these things in it and that's when my partner went and signed up an extra year with Nazarro when I had already fixed it so that I'm going to get -- see, when we were playing in Radio City Music Hall, I can go get the check because nobody knows I can't get the check but Nazarro. I can go get the check 'cause I'm part of the act and the leader of the act. So I go out and get the check…
